title: Senior Web Developer at Firegang Dental Marketing
description: The role of Senior Web Developer at Firegang Dental Marketing involves overseeing and developing high-quality web applications for our clients. We are looking for a dedicated and experienced developer who can manage multiple projects, ensure the delivery of innovative solutions, and contribute to the overall success of our digital marketing efforts. This is a remote position with opportunities for professional growth and collaboration with talented teams across the organization. The ideal candidate should have strong technical skills in front-end development, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, as well as experience working with WordPress CMS. We are seeking someone who can work independently while maintaining close relationships with our clients and team members. This is a remote position available to candidates worldwide in the U.S. The role requires excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines. We offer competitive compensation, flexible working hours, and a supportive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.
requirements: Basic knowledge of front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery; familiarity with WordPress CMS; experience managing multiple web applications; ability to work independently while maintaining close relationships with clients and team members; strong communication skills; attention to detail; proficiency in English. We are looking for a candidate who can deliver high-quality web applications that meet the highest standards of quality and functionality.
benefits: flexible working hours, remote work option, competitive salary, professional development opportunities, collaborative environment, company culture
